about: Tiny Little Office password sealing (src/kit/share/crypt.ts, docs/crypto/password.md). The password is one the app made (twenty characters from an alphabet of 56, about 116 bits); key = HKDF-SHA-256(ikm = NFKC(password) as UTF-8, salt, info = 'tinylittleoffice sealed v1' as UTF-8, 32 bytes); plaintext = the codec's flag byte then the document's bytes (flag 'r': UTF-8 as it is); sealed = 'E' + base64url without padding of salt[16] | iv[12] | AES-256-GCM(key, iv, plaintext) with its 16-byte tag last and no additional data. Fixed salts and IVs are for these vectors only: the site draws both from crypto.getRandomValues. Base64url here is RFC 4648's URL alphabet with '~' for 62 where the RFC has '-' (a hyphen is where a pasted link breaks a line), no padding; '-' is read as 62 too.
